description: Address 7 issues from semantic review: wire premium/discount filter, integrate OTE/OB as confluence filters, fix daily P&L tracking in live mode, gate connector failure in live loop, cap candle buffer, document same-candle SL/TP bias, add env var override for credentials
steps: Wire premium/discount filter into entry_model.py generate_entry_signal() to reject long signals in premium and short signals in discount
Integrate OTE and order_blocks as optional confluence filters in entry_model.py (check if entry price is in OTE zone or near an unmitigated OB)
Fix daily P&L tracking in main.py run_live() by polling closed positions and updating daily_pnl
Gate connector failure in main.py run_live() with reconnection logic and early exit when not connected
Add max-size cap (MAX_BUFFER_SIZE) to candle_buffer in entry_model.py with sliding window behavior
Document same-candle SL/TP priority assumption in backtester.py _check_trade_exit() with a clear comment
Add environment variable override support in main.py load_config() for MT5 and Telegram credentials
acceptance_criteria: Premium/discount filter is checked before generating entry signals
OTE and order_blocks modules are imported and used as confluence checks in entry model
Live mode updates daily_pnl from closed positions
Live loop exits early or reconnects when connector is not connected
candle_buffer has a maximum size cap and uses sliding window
Backtester _check_trade_exit has a comment documenting the SL-first assumption
load_config supports environment variable overrides for sensitive credentials
verification: python3 -c 'from ict_bot.entry_model import EntryModel; from ict_bot.risk_management import calculate_position_size; from ict_bot.mt5_connector import MT5Connector; print("OK")'
